$comment: What this package waits on upstream, in one place. `watches` are checked against the npm registry every week (scripts/check-upstream.mjs, run by weekly.yml's `upstream` job); `asks` are requests to the projects we build on, each with the plan item it blocks and what we do until it lands. The weekly job keeps one issue, "ci: upstream watch", in step with this file.

watches.title: @convex-dev/better-auth accepts Better Auth 1.7
watches.unblocks: UP1 — Better Auth 1.7 (lift the better-auth and @better-auth/passkey holds in dependabot.yml)

watches.title: @convex-dev/polar develops against Polar SDK 1
watches.unblocks: UP2 — Polar SDK 1.0 (lift the @polar-sh/sdk hold), and with it per-customer discount limits through the SDK (deletes src/cli/billing/discount-limit.ts, the one raw call billing sync makes)

watches.title: TypeDoc accepts TypeScript 7
watches.unblocks: TypeScript 7 for the repository (lift the typescript hold)

watches.title: Nuxt ships Nuxt DevTools 4
watches.unblocks: The DevTools kit and UI kit majors (lift the @nuxt/devtools-kit and @nuxt/devtools-ui-kit holds in dependabot.yml)

watches.title: Nuxt's server runs on h3 2
watches.unblocks: Nuxt 5 and h3 2 for the server handlers (lift the h3 hold in dependabot.yml)

watches.title: Docus moves to nuxt-og-image 7, which reads @nuxt/fonts 1
watches.unblocks: #94 — the docs site on @nuxt/fonts 1 (lift the @nuxt/fonts hold in dependabot.yml): social cards that read its fonts, and app.css fallback faces reworked for the ones it writes itself

decisions.title: Agent OAuth on @better-auth/oauth-provider
decisions.note: Decided 2026-10-14: A1a folds into UP1. Better Auth 1.7 removes the mcp plugin and reshapes the provider again. Decided 2026-10-27 (DEFER): 0.2.0 ships no end-user MCP endpoint and no OAuth tables; the endpoint returns in the release after it, on Better Auth 1.7's own MCP plugin.

asks.ask: Create the Convex client lazily, on first use
asks.blocks: R3, DEMO (docs pages that never open a socket)
asks.fallback: The site loads the client behind its own lazy plugin

asks.ask: A lazy-client option: import the Better Auth client when auth is first used, not with every page
asks.blocks: PERF (the auth client out of the starter's entry chunk)
asks.fallback: The client stays eager with every plugin registered; the passkey ceremony loads on first use through the package's own passkey plugin, and the starter budget holds the rest

asks.ask: No WebSocket during SSR or prerender
asks.blocks: C3, R3, A15 (useConvexConnectionState reads the client on the server, which opens its socket there)
asks.fallback: Client-only guards around the live parts; <ConnectionStatus> reads the connection state in the browser only

asks.ask: Read the connection state without opening the connection: a useConvexConnectionState (or a client.started signal) that waits for the client's first query, mutation or sign-in instead of creating the socket
asks.blocks: A15 (<ConnectionStatus> on every ready-made page, the sign-in page for a signed-out visitor included)
asks.fallback: <ConnectionStatus> reads the client's lazily created cachedSync, the field the module's DevTools bridge watches, and subscribes once it exists

asks.ask: Export the docs error page (docus/app/error.vue) under a stable path or component name
asks.blocks: A15 (the site's error.vue renders <AccessDenied> for a 403 and Docus's own page otherwise)
asks.fallback: website/error.vue imports it by file path; test/docs/docus-copies.test.ts pins its hash

asks.ask: Mount a named handler at its own `route`: `defineMcpHandler` documents the option, but every named handler is served at `/mcp/:handler`, under the default handler's prefix
asks.blocks: DMCP (a public docs MCP beside the toolkit's default handler, in one app)
asks.fallback: website/server/docs-mcp/server.ts serves the docs tools from a plain Nitro route on the MCP SDK's own transport, registering them with the toolkit's `registerToolFromDefinition`

asks.ask: Export the docs MCP tools (`list-pages`, `get-page`) by name, so a handler other than the auto-discovered one can serve them
asks.fallback: website/server/docs-mcp/tools.ts imports them by file path (`docus/server/mcp/tools/*`) and names them; scripts/check-website-agents.mjs calls both against every build

asks.ask: A supported testing seam, nuxt-convex-module/testing: the reset of the session token useBetterAuth caches, and the auth-client alias a test can swap
asks.fallback: backendTestAliases() reaches use-better-auth.js by path and swaps #convex/auth-client; test/unit/test-utils-aliases.test.ts fails when either moves

asks.ask: A locale-aware login path in the auth middleware
asks.fallback: The package's own middleware resolves the localized path

asks.ask: A webhook handler factory with per-event hooks: an exported (ctx, request) => Response, not only registerRoutes
asks.blocks: C6 (one webhook edge); dropping the _handler capture in src/convex/integrations/billing/webhooks.ts
asks.fallback: Capture the registered handlers through a shim router, pinned by test/unit/billing-webhook-edge.test.ts

asks.ask: Trial and cancellation columns on the subscriptions table
asks.fallback: Read them from the provider API on demand

asks.ask: Customers keyed by external id: team customers, and checkouts and portal sessions by external customer id, with no lookup by email
asks.fallback: The package creates, keys and maps each entity's customer itself, outside the component's client

asks.ask: Polar SDK 1.x support: the 1.0 rewrite breaks the client, validateEvent and syncProducts (get-convex/polar#95)
asks.fallback: Stay on @polar-sh/sdk ^0.49.0, pinned in the website and the playground; doctor's billing-provider-sdk finding warns an app that resolves 1.x

asks.ask: Better Auth 1.7 in the peer range
asks.fallback: Stay on Better Auth 1.6

asks.ask: Forward the client IP to Better Auth (rate limits, session ipAddress)
asks.blocks: A3, F5 (the passkeySignIn bucket per client address), F6
asks.fallback: Read the forwarded header in the package's proxy

asks.ask: A topicId on sends and broadcasts
asks.fallback: Call the provider SDK directly for topic-scoped sends

asks.ask: Optional React peers for presence
asks.fallback: Presence stays component-owned, behind the install-size budget

asks.ask: Restrict a discount to first-time customers
asks.fallback: The server checks for an earlier paid order before applying it

asks.ask: A metadata filter and an external_id for discounts
asks.fallback: billing sync reads the whole discount list and finds each catalog discount by the managed key in its metadata

asks.ask: Enforce per-customer discount limits on subscription updates
asks.fallback: billing.applyDiscount says the provider skips the limit there, and the docs show the app's own once-per-entity record

asks.ask: Trial-abuse matching for team customers
asks.fallback: One trial per owner, tracked by the package

asks.ask: Set a member's external_id after it was created
asks.fallback: The portal matches an adopted customer's owner member by the caller's verified email

asks.ask: Revoke the benefits a $0 order granted when the order that paid for it is refunded
asks.blocks: A4, GIFT (refunds after a gift's claim)
asks.fallback: A refund before the claim voids the gift; after it, the money is returned and the credits stay. Gifts need an earlier paid order and a per-purchaser cap

asks.ask: Trial reminder emails that show the price
asks.fallback: The package sends its own reminder

asks.ask: Refresh a synced product row when one of its benefits changes (handle benefit.updated in the component's webhook handler, or have the provider send product.updated)
asks.blocks: A7a (pricing reads a pack's or plan's credits off the product row's embedded benefits)
asks.fallback: The package re-syncs the products table on every benefit.updated delivery, best-effort, logged as billing.product_resync_failed when it fails

asks.ask: One subscription product with a price per billing interval (monthly and yearly), switchable without a product change
asks.fallback: billing sync makes one product per interval, tagged with the plan's key and the interval (<plan>, <plan>:year); getPricing groups them back into one plan

asks.ask: Discounts in the declarative catalog config (/v1/config) and a documented code lookup
asks.fallback: billing sync keeps the catalog's discounts in line itself, and a code is matched against the list the provider's query returns

asks.ask: A discount redemption webhook
asks.fallback: Read the discount off order.paid

asks.ask: lastLoginMethod's default resolver names the email OTP sign-in (/sign-in/email-otp)
asks.fallback: The package passes a customResolveMethod that names it email-otp

asks.ask: An AbortSignal for the passkey client's signIn.passkey({ autoFill })
asks.blocks: F5 (ending a passkey autofill request when its page goes away)
asks.fallback: The request waits until the next passkey ceremony, which @simplewebauthn/browser aborts it for; a flow that is gone ignores its answer

asks.ask: /passkey/verify-authentication checks the user id the challenge stored: a challenge asked for by a signed-in session answers only for that session's account
asks.blocks: A3 (re-authentication tied to the session it replaces)
asks.fallback: A re-authentication carries the x-backend-reauthenticate header; the request guard records the session it replaces, and the session-create hook refuses another account's sign-in before it is written (reauthenticatedWorkspace in src/convex/client/guards.ts)

asks.ask: A freshness option (freshSessionMiddleware) for the admin and organization plugins' write routes
asks.blocks: A3 (a recent sign-in for administrator and workspace-role writes)
asks.fallback: The request guard enforces the sensitive-action table's recentSignIn on those routes (assertSessionMay in src/convex/client/guards.ts)

asks.ask: Hand the session a route's own middleware read to the request after-hooks (ctx.context.session), as the before-hooks and the database hooks see it
asks.blocks: F4a (who acted on an audit event of a workspace or administrator route)
asks.fallback: The request guard's before-hook reads the caller as the route will and keeps it for the after-hook (noteRouteBefore in src/convex/client/audit.ts)

asks.ask: Run the database after-hooks of a route before its request after-hooks, or document the order they run in
asks.blocks: F4a (a re-authentication's new session recorded as one, not as a sign-in)
asks.fallback: revokeSuperseded in src/convex/client/guards.ts marks the replaced session revoked instead of dropping it, so the new session's database hook still reads it as a re-authentication

asks.ask: A route that revokes a connected agent (its consent and its tokens), in the mcp plugin or the OAuth provider that replaces it
asks.blocks: The connected-agents page of the release after 0.2.0, with the end-user MCP endpoint (DEFER)
asks.fallback: None needed in 0.2.0: no agent connects

asks.ask: Let `discovery.mcpServerCard` describe a server the toolkit does not mount: its `authentication` and its tools from the config, not from the toolkit handler's definitions, and a card per host
asks.blocks: D7a, DMCP (the site has no MCP endpoint of its own, so its card describes the docs MCP at the docs host)
asks.fallback: website/server/plugins/agent-surfaces.ts sets the docs MCP's name, endpoint, authentication, capabilities and tools through the `agent-discovery:mcp-server-card` hook; nuxt.config.ts keeps the card from prerendering, so it answers per host

asks.ask: List the tools other modules contribute through `mcp:definitions:paths` on the MCP server card, or leave the lists out when it sees none
asks.fallback: The same hook replaces the tool list with the docs MCP's, and drops the empty resource and prompt lists; llmsSections is the llms.txt workaround below

asks.ask: Let a content-backed llms.txt section list its pages in navigation order, not `path` order
asks.fallback: nuxt.config.ts lists each tab section's links itself, from readDocsPages and llmsSections (website/shared/agent-surfaces.ts)

asks.ask: Name the function a server fetcher failed in (fetchQuery, fetchMutation, fetchAction, preloadQuery), as the browser client does with its `[CONVEX X(path)]` prefix, or call a hook with the reference and the error
asks.blocks: MON (the backend.function tag on a failed plain fetchQuery, fetchMutation or fetchAction made from a server route)
asks.fallback: backendAuth(event)'s calls are wrapped at their call site; a plain fetcher's failure reaches the error-reporting SDK through Nitro's error handler, tagged with its code but not its function

asks.ask: Tell a function a component lacks from a deployment that did not answer: `convex function-spec --component <path>`, or a distinct exit code or JSON error from `convex run --component` for a missing function
asks.blocks: UPG (`nuxt-backend upgrade` says a deployment runs an older backend, and to push it first)
asks.fallback: The upgrade reads the end of `convex run`'s error output, which is the component's function list the CLI prints after "Could not find function"

asks.ask: Publish @vercel/firewall with npm provenance again: 1.2.3 to 1.2.6 carry none, where 1.2.2 and earlier did, so pnpm's trust policy refuses them
asks.fallback: website/package.json pins 1.2.2, .github/dependabot.yml ignores the package until then, and website/server/middleware/0.firewall.ts races the check against its own one-second timeout

asks.ask: Make `checkRateLimit` answer `rateLimited: false` off Vercel, as it already does in development, rather than calling the request's own host from a production build anywhere else
asks.fallback: website/server/middleware/0.firewall.ts checks the Firewall only when `VERCEL` is set

asks.ask: Let the Nuxt modules of @vercel/analytics and @vercel/speed-insights take options (an `enabled` flag, or skipping their script off Vercel): today each always injects it, a debug script from the CDN in dev and a `/_vercel/…` path no other host serves
asks.fallback: website/nuxt.config.ts installs both modules in a Vercel build only (website/shared/vercel.ts)

asks.ask: Let the assistant's system prompt follow the MCP server it is pointed at, or take extra instructions from `docus.assistant`: it names only `list-pages` and `get-page`, whatever tools the server offers
asks.blocks: SITE (the docs MCP's search and lookups, which the prompt does not mention)
asks.fallback: Docus's own prompt, which the site's endpoint takes from getAssistantDefaultOptions as it is: the model sees the other tools by their names and descriptions only

asks.ask: Let the built-in assistant endpoint check what the chat sends before the model sees it: the roles (no client-sent `system` message), a cap on the question and on the history, and the history as text without the tool results the chat sends back
asks.blocks: SITE (Docus's own assistant handler, which passes the client's whole conversation to the model unchecked)
asks.fallback: website/server/routes/__docus__/assistant.ts serves the endpoint from Docus's helpers with those checks in front (website/shared/assistant.ts), and Docus leaves its own handler out

asks.ask: Support Better Auth's `listUsers` paging on the Convex adapter: `/admin/list-users` passes an `offset`, which the adapter refuses ("offset not supported"), so only its first page can be read
asks.blocks: F7 (the admin console's user list through Better Auth's own admin route)
asks.fallback: setupAdmin (src/convex/integrations/admin.ts) reads accounts and workspaces through the component adapter's `findMany` by cursor, and the console's writes stay Better Auth's admin routes

asks.ask: Delete a customer and its subscriptions: a mutation that removes the synced rows of one user id, for an account erasure
asks.blocks: F8 (complete erasure: the synced customers and subscriptions of a deleted account's billing entities)
asks.fallback: The erasure deletes and anonymizes the customer at the provider and leaves the synced rows, which name the billing entity's id and never an address or a name; the Privacy and data inventory page lists them as kept
